questions.question: 1. What does Maximum Sustainable Yield (MSY) represent?

answers.a: The maximum number of predators supported by an ecosystem
answers.b: The maximum number of individuals that can be harvested indefinitely without causing population collapse
answers.c: The carrying capacity of the habitat
answers.d: The highest population density achieved during exponential growth

answers.a: The number of individuals removed by harvesting
answers.b: The number of predators entering the population
answers.c: The number of new individuals added to the existing population
answers.d: The carrying capacity of the environment

questions.question: 3. What is the effect of increasing the harvesting rate beyond the sustainable level?

answers.b: The prey population may decline and eventually collapse
answers.d: Recruitment rate becomes independent of population size

questions.question: 4. According to the theory, why is harvesting generally maintained below the Maximum Sustainable Yield?

answers.b: To ensure a lower carrying capacity
answers.c: To reduce the risk of population, collapse and maintain long-term sustainability
answers.d: To eliminate competition within the population

questions.question: 5. In the simulator, the parameter θ (theta) represents:

answers.c: Spatial distribution of individuals in the population
